categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Shengbang Seals Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of high polymer rubber sealing and insulating products. Its main business segments include automotive seals, electrical insulation and sealing products, aerospace rubber components, nuclear protection products, and other synthetic rubber and plastic products. The company serves industries such as automotive (including traditional and new energy vehicles), electrical power equipment, aerospace, and nuclear protection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced polymer material science, proprietary rubber compound formulations, and precision mold design and manufacturing. It employs CAD/CAE design, finite element analysis for product optimization, and automated production lines integrating robotics and intelligent manufacturing systems. It has strong capabilities in custom product development, material compatibility research, and comprehensive testing and quality control, supported by multiple patents and national-level research centers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive manufacturers (e.g., BYD, Geely, Great Wall, SAIC), electrical equipment companies (e.g., Schneider, ABB), aerospace and defense entities (e.g., AVIC subsidiaries), and nuclear industry organizations (e.g., CGN and CNNC affiliates). The company’s products are used in automotive engines, transmissions, electric vehicle battery packs, electrical switchgear, aircraft components, and nuclear radiation protection equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. It also exports products to international markets including France, India, Czech Republic, USA, Hungary, Malaysia, Vietnam, Australia, and Germany. Domestic sales constitute over 90% of revenue, with export sales growing steadily.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Shengbang Seals operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of specialized rubber and polymer sealing and insulating components. It sources raw materials like rubber and metal components from upstream suppliers and supplies finished parts directly to downstream OEMs and equipment manufacturers in automotive, electrical, aerospace, and nuclear sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology leadership, market penetration, and green manufacturing. R&D priorities include developing new materials and products for new energy vehicles, high-voltage electrical equipment, aerospace, and nuclear protection. It invests in intelligent manufacturing, digitalization, and automation to improve efficiency and product quality. The company also pursues intellectual property development and collaborates with universities and research institutes to enhance innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized rubber and polymer sealing and insulating products to industrial customers. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with contracts and orders from OEMs and industrial clients. It also earns investment income from cash management activities. The sales model includes domestic direct sales and export sales based on customer orders.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading domestic high-tech enterprise in polymer sealing products with strong R&D capabilities and a broad product portfolio. It holds national-level certifications and industry leadership roles, enabling it to compete effectively in automotive, electrical, aerospace, and nuclear markets. Its focus on innovation, customization, and quality differentiates it from peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 404.45 million, an 18.95% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 87.00 million, up 35.88%. The company’s asset base exceeded RMB 1 billion, with steady growth in net assets and profitability. It maintains a healthy growth trajectory supported by expanding market demand, especially in new energy vehicles and electrical sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chengdu Shengbang Seals offers high-performance, customized sealing and insulating solutions tailored to the specific technical and environmental requirements of its customers. Its competitive advantages include advanced material formulations, proprietary design and manufacturing technologies, comprehensive testing capabilities, and strong intellectual property. The company emphasizes green manufacturing, intelligent production, and close collaboration with customers to deliver reliable, innovative products that meet evolving industry standards and regulatory requirements.
